items.title: President Trump awards Big Tech donors with nation’s highest science prizes
items.summary: On Thursday, President Trump awarded Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Sergey Brin, and AMD’s Lisa Su the National Medal of Science, the nation’s top science prize.
items.creator: Dominic-Madori Davis

items.title: Elon Musk questions Ambani’s influence as Starlink India launch stalls
items.summary: “Is Ambani the real boss of India?” Elon Musk asked as he questioned why Starlink has yet to launch its satellite internet service in the country.
items.creator: Jagmeet Singh
